    <!-- DB Upgrade Utility Placeholder -->
    <UpgradeAR_DB_Holder/>

    <!-- Main Container -->
    <div class="status-container" style="width: 100%">

        <!-- Tab Navigation — EMPTY by design: every tab comes from an installed pack -->
        <div class="tab-nav">
        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Templates -->
    
    <!-- Every built-in template carries ONE slot for row verbs and no verb of its own (D8): the
         renderer fills it from the list cell's declared rowActions plus its allowDelete flag. -->

    <!-- Simple List Template -->
    <template id="tmpl-simple">
        <div class="list-entry" style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
            <div>
                <div class="entry-title" data-slot="title"></div>
                <div class="entry-desc" data-slot="desc"></div>
            </div>
            <span class="row-actions" data-slot="row-actions"></span>
        </div>
    </template>

    <!-- Grid List Template -->
    <template id="tmpl-grid">
        <div class="grid-tile" style="position:relative;">
            <span class="tile-name" data-slot="name"></span>
            <span class="tile-qty" data-slot="qty"></span>
            <span class="row-actions" data-slot="row-actions" style="position:absolute; top:2px; right:2px;"></span>
        </div>
    </template>

    <!-- Inventory List Template -->
    <template id="tmpl-inventory">
        <div class="grid-tile" style="cursor:pointer; position:relative; display:flex; flex-direction:row; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:6px 10px; height:100%; min-height:40px; text-align:left; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:4px; gap: 8px;">
            <span class="tile-name" style="font-weight:bold; pointer-events:none; flex: 1; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" data-slot="name" title=""></span>
            <span class="tile-qty" style="pointer-events:none; flex-shrink: 0;" data-slot="qty"></span>
            <span class="row-actions" data-slot="row-actions"></span>
            <div style="display:none" data-slot="desc"></div>
        </div>
    </template>

    <!-- Equipment List Template -->
    <template id="tmpl-equipment-action">
        <div class="list-entry" style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
            <div>
                <div class="entry-title" data-slot="title"></div>
                <div class="entry-desc" data-slot="desc"></div>
            </div>
            <span class="row-actions" data-slot="row-actions"></span>

const isTuple = (v) => Array.isArray(v) && v.length >= 2 && typeof v[1] === 'string';
const tupleVal = (v) => isTuple(v) ? v[0] : v;

// --- Helper Functions ---
// Lodash: the frame's OWN first, the parent's only inside a try. In a contained frame (mvu-helper's
// sandboxed mount) the origin is opaque and reading ANY property of window.parent throws; this line
// runs at module top level, so an unguarded parent read here would kill every helper below it and the
// whole menu with them. TavernHelper's frame sets window._ to the parent's lodash itself, so the
// own-window branch is the same lodash there.
const _ = (() => {
    if (typeof window._ !== 'undefined' && window._) return window._;
    try {
        return (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent._) || null;
    } catch (e) {
        console.info('[MZSMB] parent lodash is not reachable (contained frame) - using the built-in path reader:', e && e.message);
        return null;
    }
})();

const getRaw = (obj, path, def) => {
    if (!obj) return def;
    if (!path) return obj;
    
    // Native Lodash support (Robust path handling)
    if (_ && _.get) {
        return _.get(obj, path, def);
    }

    // Fallback
    const parts = path.split('.');
    let cur = obj;
    for (const p of parts) {
        if (cur === undefined || cur === null) return def;
        cur = cur[p];
    }
    return (cur === undefined || cur === null) ? def : cur;
};

const getV = (obj, path, def) => {
     const val = getRaw(obj, path, def);
     if (isTuple(val)) return val[0];
     return val;
};

const getListData = (obj, path, def) => {
    const raw = getRaw(obj, path, def);
    
    // 1. Explicit Schema Override: If user marked as Collection (Record), force it to be a List.
    // Schema paths start with '.', so we check both 'path' and '.path'
    if (COLLECTION_PATHS.has(path) || COLLECTION_PATHS.has('.' + path)) {
        return raw;
    }

    // 2. Strict Mode: No Heuristics. 
    // If it's a tuple [List, Label], we return it as-is.
    // User must target 'path.0' or use Schema to control structure.
    return raw;
};

const getL = (obj, path, def) => {
    const val = getRaw(obj, path, def);
    if (isTuple(val)) return val[1];
    return def; 
};

const formatValue = (val) => {
    if (val === null || val === undefined) return LOCALE.empty_none;
    if (isTuple(val)) return formatValue(tupleVal(val));
    if (Array.isArray(val)) return JSON.stringify(val);
    if (typeof val === 'object') {
        if (val.Desc !== undefined) return formatValue(val.Desc);
        if (val.description !== undefined) return formatValue(val.description);
        if (val.name !== undefined) return formatValue(val.name);
        return null; 
    }
    return val;
};

const tupleLabel = (v, fallback) => isTuple(v) ? (v[1] || fallback) : fallback;

const setVal = (obj, path, newVal) => {
    const raw = getRaw(obj, path);
    if (isTuple(raw)) {
        if (_ && _.set) _.set(obj, path, [newVal, raw[1]]);
        else {
            const parts = path.split('.');
            let cur = obj;
            for (let i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) cur = cur[parts[i]];
            cur[parts[parts.length - 1]] = [newVal, raw[1]];
        }
    } else {
        if (_ && _.set) _.set(obj, path, newVal);
        else {
            const parts = path.split('.');
            let cur = obj;
            for (let i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) cur = cur[parts[i]];
            cur[parts[parts.length - 1]] = newVal;

};

function getItemSummary(item) {
    if (typeof item !== 'object' || !item) return { name: String(item), qty: '' };

    const nameKeys = ['Name', 'name'];

// The step counter a quest card shows, as ONE string the template binds blind: "2/3" when the record
// carries a positive Step AND a positive StepMax (the ladder RES stamps on an ad-hoc quest), '' for
// anything else — a signpost's bare cursor with no total, an older genre's record with neither, a Zod
// prefault 0 — so the row hides rather than print half a readout. Tuples unwrap the way every other
// field does. The join happens HERE: the template stays zero-logic. Exported for the node suite.
export function questStepLabel(stepRaw, stepMaxRaw) {
    const num = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null) ? NaN : Number(isTuple(v) ? tupleVal(v) : v);
    const step = num(stepRaw), max = num(stepMaxRaw);
    if (!Number.isFinite(step) || step <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(max) || max <= 0) return '';
    return step + '/' + max;
}

                     if (key === '$meta' || key === '$key' || key === 'template' || value === null || value === undefined) continue;
                     const unwrapped = isTuple(value) ? tupleVal(value) : value;

                         res.push({ ...(!hasName ? { Name: key } : {}), ...unwrapped, $key: key });

    if (newTab) newTab.classList.add('active');
    btn.classList.add('active');

    // If selecting a collection tab, always reset list/block paging and scroll to top.
    const isCollectionTab = (() => {
        if (!newTab) return false;
        const bindRoots = newTab.querySelectorAll('[data-bind-root]');
        for (const el of bindRoots) {
            const root = el.getAttribute('data-bind-root');
            if (root && (COLLECTION_PATHS.has(root) || COLLECTION_PATHS.has('.' + root))) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    })();
    
    // 2. Set parent #chat scroll based on visit history
    try {
        if (window.parent && window.parent !== window) {
            const chatEl = window.parent.document.querySelector('#chat');
            if (chatEl) {
                let targetY = 0;
                const chatRect = chatEl.getBoundingClientRect();
                
                // First-time visits → scroll to iframe position (top of status menu, not top of chat)
                if (!tabVisited[tabId]) {
                    const iframe = window.frameElement;
                    if (iframe) {
                        const iframeRect = iframe.getBoundingClientRect();
                        targetY = chatEl.scrollTop + iframeRect.top - chatRect.top;
                    }
                }
                // Previously visited tabs → restore saved position
                else if (tabScrollStates[tabId] !== undefined) {
                    targetY = tabScrollStates[tabId];
                }
                
                // Mark this tab as visited
                tabVisited[tabId] = true;
                
                // Apply scroll immediately (may be clamped if collection tab content hasn't rendered yet)
                const maxScrollTop = chatEl.scrollHeight - chatEl.clientHeight;
                const wasClamped = targetY > maxScrollTop;
                chatEl.scrollTop = targetY;

                // If clamped, the tab's content (e.g. a long Partner list) hasn't fully rendered yet.
                // Re-apply after 150ms once scrollHeight has expanded, recalculating from fresh measurements.
                if (wasClamped) {
                    pendingScrollReapplyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                        try {
                            const iframe = window.frameElement;
                            if (iframe) {
                                const freshIframeRect = iframe.getBoundingClientRect();
                                const freshChatRect = chatEl.getBoundingClientRect();
                                const freshTargetY = chatEl.scrollTop + freshIframeRect.top - freshChatRect.top;
                                const freshMax = chatEl.scrollHeight - chatEl.clientHeight;
                                chatEl.scrollTop = Math.max(0, Math.min(freshTargetY, freshMax));
                            }
                        } catch(e) { /* cross-origin */ }
                        pendingScrollReapplyTimer = null;
                    }, 150);
                }

            }
        }
    } catch (e) { /* cross-origin */ }
    
    // Also reset internal scroll in case there's no iframe wrapper
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    document.documentElement.scrollTop = 0;
    document.body.scrollTop = 0;
}

// `origin` (optional): { scopePath, cellArgsText } — where the row sat and what its list cell
// declared, both observations the save posts along with the form's strings.
function showModal(title, data, allowEdit, listPath, itemKey, origin) {
    const scopePath = origin && origin.scopePath ? String(origin.scopePath) : '';
    const cellArgsText = origin ? origin.cellArgsText : null;
    const modal = openDetailModal(title);
    if (!modal) return;
    const { context, theme: _theme, body: elBody, footer: elFooter } = modal;
    const _accent = _theme.accent;
    const _text = _theme.text;
    const _border = _theme.border;

    // Sanitize text to prevent XSS when inserting into HTML
    // Entities use \u0026 escapes — see escapeHtml in rt_htmlGenerators.js. The document ships as an
    // iframe `srcdoc` attribute, which is entity-decoded once, so a literal entity here silently
    // becomes the character it was meant to escape and this function stops escaping anything.
    const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/&/g,'\u0026amp;').replace(/</g,'\u0026lt;').replace(/>/g,'\u0026gt;').replace(/"/g,'\u0026quot;');
    
    // Recursive formatter with inline styles (read-only view)
    const formatData = (obj) => {
        if (obj === null || obj === undefined) return `<span style="color:${_theme.textSecondary}">null</span>`;
        if (typeof obj !== 'object') return esc(String(obj));
        
        let html = '';
        if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
            html += `<div style="padding-left:10px; border-left:1px solid ${_border}">`;
            obj.forEach((v, i) => {
                html += `<div><span style="color:${_theme.textSecondary}">[${i}]</span> ${formatData(v)}</div>`;
            });
            html += '</div>';
        } else {
            html += `<div style="padding-left:10px; border-left:2px solid ${_accent}">`;
            for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
                if (k === '$meta' || k === 'template' || k === '$key' || k === 'name') continue;
                 html += `<div style="padding:4px 0; border-bottom:1px dotted ${_border};"><span style="color:${_accent}; font-weight:bold;">${esc(k)}:</span> <span style="color:${_text};">${formatData(v)}</span></div>`;
            }
            html += '</div>';
        }
        return html;
    };

    // Build editable form (flat key-value inputs for top-level fields)
    const buildEditForm = (obj) => {
        const wrap = context.document.createElement('div');
        wrap.style.cssText = `padding-left:10px; border-left:2px solid ${_accent};`;
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
            if (k === '$meta' || k === 'template' || k === '$key' || k === 'name') continue;
            const row = context.document.createElement('div');
            row.style.cssText = `padding:4px 0; border-bottom:1px dotted ${_border}; display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:8px;`;
            
            const label = context.document.createElement('span');
            label.style.cssText = `color:${_accent}; font-weight:bold; min-width:80px; padding-top:6px; flex-shrink:0;`;
            label.textContent = k + ':';
            
            const isObj = v !== null && typeof v === 'object';
            // Always use textarea: easier to edit long strings, still fine for short ones
            const input = context.document.createElement('textarea');
            input.setAttribute('data-field', k);
            input.style.cssText = `flex:1; background:${_theme.tint(8)}; border:1px solid ${_border}; color:${_text}; padding:4px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-size:0.9em; font-family:inherit; resize:vertical; box-sizing:border-box;`;
            if (isObj) {
                input.value = JSON.stringify(v, null, 2);
            } else {
                input.value = v === null || v === undefined ? '' : String(v);
            }
            // Auto-size: rows based on content length and newlines
            const lines = input.value.split('\n').length;
            const charsPerRow = 40; // rough estimate for wrapping
            const wrappedRows = Math.ceil(input.value.length / charsPerRow);
            input.rows = Math.min(12, Math.max(2, lines, wrappedRows));

            row.appendChild(label);
            row.appendChild(input);
            wrap.appendChild(row);
        }
        return wrap;
    };
    
    // Render read-only view
    elBody.innerHTML = formatData(data);

    // Add Edit button if allowEdit is enabled
    if (allowEdit && elFooter && listPath && itemKey) {
        const editBtn = context.document.createElement('button');
        editBtn.textContent = '✏ Edit';
        editBtn.style.cssText = `background:${_theme.tint(15)}; border:1px solid ${_theme.tint(40)}; color:${_accent}; padding:6px 16px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.9em;`;
        
        editBtn.onclick = () => {
            // Switch to edit mode
            elBody.innerHTML = '';
            const form = buildEditForm(data);
            elBody.appendChild(form);
            elFooter.innerHTML = '';
            
            const saveBtn = context.document.createElement('button');
            saveBtn.textContent = '💾 Save';
            saveBtn.style.cssText = `background:rgba(0,200,100,0.2); border:1px solid rgba(0,200,100,0.5); color:#00c864; padding:6px 16px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.9em;`;
            
            const cancelBtn = context.document.createElement('button');
            cancelBtn.textContent = 'Cancel';
            cancelBtn.style.cssText = `background:rgba(255,100,100,0.15); border:1px solid rgba(255,100,100,0.4); color:#ff6b6b; padding:6px 16px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.9em;`;
            
            cancelBtn.onclick = () => {
                // Revert to read-only view
                elBody.innerHTML = formatData(data);
                elFooter.innerHTML = '';
                elFooter.appendChild(editBtn);
            };
            
            saveBtn.onclick = async () => {
                // The form posts STRINGS — what was typed, per field, nothing more. What each field
                // IS (a number, a flag, text) is the engine's editListItem, from the pack's own
                // table; deciding it here from how the text looked was the observer judging.
                const fields = {};
                form.querySelectorAll('[data-field]').forEach(inp => { fields[inp.getAttribute('data-field')] = inp.value; });
                const merged = mergeCellArgs(cellArgsText, { listPath, itemKey, fields });
                if (merged.reason) console.warn('[MZSMB][action] editListItem: ' + merged.reason + ' — posting without the cell\'s args');
                saveBtn.disabled = true;
                const result = await dispatchMenuAction('editListItem', merged.args, scopePath, { button: saveBtn });
                saveBtn.disabled = false;
                if (!result.ok) { alert('Edit not saved: ' + result.reason); return; }

                // The host wrote and this frame re-read; show the item as it now IS, never as typed.
                const fresh = typeof getRaw === 'function' ? getRaw(_lastStatData, listPath + '.' + itemKey, null) : null;
                if (fresh && typeof fresh === 'object') {
                    for (const k of Object.keys(data)) delete data[k];
                    Object.assign(data, fresh);
                }
                elBody.innerHTML = formatData(data);
                elFooter.innerHTML = '';
                elFooter.appendChild(editBtn);
            };
            
            elFooter.appendChild(cancelBtn);
            elFooter.appendChild(saveBtn);
        };
        
        elFooter.appendChild(editBtn);
    }

    modal.show();
}

        // Helper to create pagination controls
function createBlockPaginationBar(containerId, currentPage, totalPages, data, templateId, position, allItems, effectivePageSize) {
    const bar = document.createElement('div');
    bar.className = 'block-pagination-bar';
    // Use width:100% and flex properties to ensure it spans full width in grid/flex containers
    bar.style.cssText = 'display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; padding:6px 4px; width:100%; flex-basis:100%; flex-shrink:0; box-sizing:border-box; ' + 
        (position === 'top' ? 'margin-bottom:8px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color);' : 'margin-top:8px; border-top:1px solid var(--border-color);');

    // Previous Button
    const prevBtn = document.createElement('button');
    prevBtn.textContent = '<';
    prevBtn.className = 'pager-btn';
    prevBtn.disabled = currentPage === 0;
    if (prevBtn.disabled) prevBtn.style.opacity = '0.3';
    prevBtn.onclick = (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (currentPage > 0) {
            _blockPageState.set(containerId, currentPage - 1);
            renderBlock(containerId, data, templateId);
        }
    };

    // Page Indicator
    const pageIndicator = document.createElement('span');
    pageIndicator.style.cssText = 'color:var(--text-secondary); font-size:0.85em;';
    pageIndicator.textContent = (currentPage + 1) + ' / ' + totalPages;

    // Next Button
    const nextBtn = document.createElement('button');
    nextBtn.textContent = '>';
    nextBtn.className = 'pager-btn';
    nextBtn.disabled = currentPage >= totalPages - 1;
    if (nextBtn.disabled) nextBtn.style.opacity = '0.3';
    nextBtn.onclick = (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (currentPage < totalPages - 1) {
            _blockPageState.set(containerId, currentPage + 1);
            renderBlock(containerId, data, templateId);
        }
    };

    bar.appendChild(prevBtn);

    // Quick-Jump Dropdown (top bar only)
    if (position === 'top' && allItems && allItems.length > 0) {
        const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
        const showQuickJump = container && container.getAttribute('data-quick-jump') === '1';
        if (showQuickJump) {
            const jumpSelect = document.createElement('select');
            jumpSelect.className = 'block-jump-select';
            const firstVisibleIdx = currentPage * effectivePageSize;
            for (let i = 0; i < allItems.length; i++) {
                const opt = document.createElement('option');
                opt.value = String(i);
                opt.style.background = '#1a1d24';
                opt.style.color = '#e0e0e0';
                const item = allItems[i];
                const name = (item.Name ? (Array.isArray(item.Name) ? item.Name[0] : item.Name) : null) || item.$key || ('Item ' + (i + 1));
                opt.textContent = name;
                if (i === firstVisibleIdx) opt.selected = true;
                jumpSelect.appendChild(opt);
            }
            jumpSelect.onchange = () => {
                const selectedIdx = parseInt(jumpSelect.value, 10);
                const targetPage = Math.floor(selectedIdx / effectivePageSize);
                const currentPage = _blockPageState.get(containerId) || 0;
                // Only rebuild DOM if the page actually changes
                if (targetPage !== currentPage) {
                    _blockPageState.set(containerId, targetPage);
                    renderBlock(containerId, data, templateId);
                    // Restore the selection on the newly-rendered select (renderBlock rebuilds DOM)
                    const newContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
                    if (newContainer) {
                        const newSelect = newContainer.querySelector('.block-jump-select');
                        if (newSelect) newSelect.value = String(selectedIdx);
                    }
                }
                // Scroll in RAF so DOM layout is stable before measuring positions
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    const anchorId = containerId + '-item-' + selectedIdx;
                    const anchor = document.getElementById(anchorId);
                    if (anchor) {
                        // The chat scroller is the parent page's. A contained frame cannot reach it (the
                        // read throws), and the anchor then scrolls into view inside the frame instead.
                        let chatEl = null;
                        try {
                            chatEl = window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.document && window.parent.document.querySelector('#chat');
                        } catch (e) {
                            chatEl = null;   // EXPECTED: a contained frame has an opaque origin; scrollIntoView below is its path
                        }
                        if (chatEl) {
                            const iframeEl = window.frameElement;
                            const iframeRect = iframeEl ? iframeEl.getBoundingClientRect() : { top: 0 };
                            const chatRect = chatEl.getBoundingClientRect();
                            const anchorRect = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
                            const scrollDelta = (iframeRect.top + anchorRect.top) - chatRect.top - 8;
                            chatEl.scrollTop += scrollDelta;
                        } else {
                            anchor.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                        }
                    }
                });
            };
            bar.appendChild(jumpSelect);
        }
    }

    bar.appendChild(pageIndicator);
    bar.appendChild(nextBtn);
    return bar;
}

function renderBlock(containerId, data, templateId, rootData) {
     const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
     const template = document.getElementById(templateId);
     if (!container || !template) return;
     
     container.innerHTML = '';
     if (!data || (typeof data === 'object' && Object.keys(data).length === 0)) {
         container.innerHTML = '<div style="width:100%; text-align:center; padding:10px; color:#666;">No Data</div>';
         return;
     }

     // Determine items to loop
     let items = [];
     if (Array.isArray(data)) {
         items = data;
     } else if (typeof data === 'object') {
         // STRICT MODE: Check Schema (COLLECTION_PATHS)
         const rootKey = container.getAttribute('data-bind-root');
         const isSchemaCollection = COLLECTION_PATHS.has(rootKey) || COLLECTION_PATHS.has('.' + rootKey);
         
         if (!isSchemaCollection) {
            items = [data]; // Treat as single Record
         } else {
             // It is a Collection -> Loop values
             items = Object.entries(data)
                 .filter(([k, v]) => k !== '$meta' && k !== '$key' && k !== 'template' && v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v))
                 .map(([k, v]) => ({ $key: k, ...v }));
         }
     } else {
         items = [data];
     }

     if (items.length === 0) {
         container.innerHTML = '<div style="width:100%; text-align:center; padding:10px; color:#666;">No Data</div>';
         return;
     }

     // --- Block Pagination Logic ---
     const totalItems = items.length;
     const effectivePageSize = parseInt(container.getAttribute('data-page-size'), 10) || BLOCK_PAGE_SIZE;
     const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalItems / effectivePageSize);
     const needsPagination = totalItems > effectivePageSize;

     let currentPage = _blockPageState.get(containerId) || 0;
     if (currentPage >= totalPages) currentPage = totalPages - 1;
     if (currentPage < 0) currentPage = 0;
     _blockPageState.set(containerId, currentPage);

     const startIdx = needsPagination ? currentPage * effectivePageSize : 0;
     const endIdx = needsPagination ? Math.min(startIdx + effectivePageSize, totalItems) : totalItems;
     const visibleItems = items.slice(startIdx, endIdx);

     // Add TOP pagination bar
     if (needsPagination) {
         container.appendChild(createBlockPaginationBar(containerId, currentPage, totalPages, data, templateId, 'top', items, effectivePageSize));
     } else if (container.getAttribute('data-quick-jump') === '1' && items.length > 0) {
         // Show quick-jump dropdown even without pagination (e.g. single item collections)
         container.appendChild(createBlockPaginationBar(containerId, currentPage, totalPages, data, templateId, 'top', items, effectivePageSize));
     }

     // Render visible items
     for (let i = 0; i < visibleItems.length; i++) {
         const item = visibleItems[i];
         const globalIdx = startIdx + i;
         const anchor = document.createElement('div');
         anchor.id = containerId + '-item-' + globalIdx;
         anchor.style.cssText = 'height:0;margin:0;padding:0;width:100%;flex-basis:100%;flex-shrink:0;';
         container.appendChild(anchor);
         const clone = template.content.cloneNode(true);
         const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
         wrapper.style.display = 'contents';
         // The item's identity, readable from the DOM — pack formatter cells resolve per ITEM and
         // look their scope up via closest('[data-item-key]') (rt_packLayout).
         if (item && item.$key !== undefined) wrapper.setAttribute('data-item-key', String(item.$key));
         wrapper.appendChild(clone);
         container.appendChild(wrapper);
         updateBindingsIn(wrapper, item, rootData);
     }

     // Add BOTTOM pagination bar
     if (needsPagination) {
         container.appendChild(createBlockPaginationBar(containerId, currentPage, totalPages, data, templateId, 'bottom', items, effectivePageSize));
     }

     // After rendering, scroll the parent tab to top if this is a collection in the active tab
     const rootKey = container.getAttribute('data-bind-root');
     const isCollection = COLLECTION_PATHS.has(rootKey) || COLLECTION_PATHS.has('.' + rootKey);
     if (isCollection) {
         const parentTab = container.closest('.tab-content');
         if (parentTab && parentTab.classList.contains('active')) {
             // Use requestAnimationFrame to ensure scroll happens after browser layout
             requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                 parentTab.scrollTop = 0;
             });
         }
     }
}

const _collapseState = new Map();

function updateBindingsIn(root, data, rootData) {
     if (!root || !data) return;
     
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-bind-val]').forEach(el => {

            const label = getL(data, path, null);

// Generic function to retrieve simple string content from a Lorebook Entry
async function fetchLorebookContent(key) {
    if (!key) return null;
    const searchKey = String(key).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (_lbContentCache.has(searchKey)) return _lbContentCache.get(searchKey);
    


    try {
        // A contained frame (mvu-helper's sandboxed mount) has no book to search: it asks the host for
        // ONE entry's content by key, and the host matches keys[] / comment exactly as below.
        if (window.MvuHelperFrame && typeof window.MvuHelperFrame.lorebookContent === 'function') {
            const hosted = await window.MvuHelperFrame.lorebookContent(searchKey);
            if (hosted) _lbContentCache.set(searchKey, hosted);
            return hosted || null;
        }

        // API Discovery (Match statusmenu.html exactly)
        const _getPrimaryBook = (typeof getCurrentCharPrimaryLorebook === 'function')
            ? getCurrentCharPrimaryLorebook
            : (window.parent && window.parent.getCurrentCharPrimaryLorebook);

        const _getEntries = (typeof getLorebookEntries === 'function')
            ? getLorebookEntries
            : (window.parent && window.parent.getLorebookEntries);

        if (typeof _getPrimaryBook === 'function' && typeof _getEntries === 'function') {
            const bookName = await _getPrimaryBook();
            // console.log("[MZSMB] [LB] Primary Book:", bookName);
            if (bookName) {
                const entries = await _getEntries(bookName);
                if (Array.isArray(entries)) {
                     const entry = entries.find(e => {
                         // Check Keys (Array)
                         if (Array.isArray(e.keys)) {
                             if (e.keys.some(k => k.trim().toLowerCase() === searchKey)) return true;
                         }
                         // Check Comment
                         if (e.comment && e.comment.trim().toLowerCase() === searchKey) return true;
                         return false;
                     });
                     
                     if (entry && entry.content) {
                         const content = entry.content.trim();
                         _lbContentCache.set(searchKey, content);
                         return content;
                     }
                }
            }
        }
    } catch(e) { console.error("[MZSMB][LB] Fetch Error:", e); }
    return null;
}

async function updateLorebookContent(root) {

const parseMessageIdFromName = (name) => {
    if (!name || typeof name !== 'string' || !name.includes('message')) return -1;
    const match = name.match(/message.*?(\d+)/i);
    if (!match) return -1;
    const parsed = Number(match[1]);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= 0 ? parsed : -1;
};

const resolveCurrentMessageId = () => {
    // 1. Prefer SillyTavern API over iframe name to avoid stale IDs.
    if (typeof getCurrentMessageId === "function") {
        const apiId = Number(getCurrentMessageId());
        if (Number.isFinite(apiId) && apiId >= 0) return apiId;
    }

    // 2. Iframe name
    const frameId = parseMessageIdFromName(window.name);
    if (frameId >= 0) return frameId;

    // 3. Parent Iframe name
    let parentName = '';
    try {
        parentName = window.parent && window.parent !== window ? window.parent.name : '';
    } catch (e) {
        parentName = '';   // EXPECTED: a contained frame cannot read the parent's name; step 1 answers there
    }
    const parentFrameId = parseMessageIdFromName(parentName);
    if (parentFrameId >= 0) return parentFrameId;

    return -1;
};

// --- Local Image Compression ---
function compressLocalImage(file, opts) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        if (!file) return reject(new Error('no_file'));
        const maxSide = (opts && opts.maxSide) || 512;
        const maxBytes = (opts && opts.maxBytes) || 240 * 1024;
        const minQuality = (opts && opts.minQuality) || 0.5;
        let quality = (opts && opts.quality) || 0.85;

        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('read_failed'));
        reader.onload = () => {
            const img = new Image();
            img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('decode_failed'));
            img.onload = () => {
                const longest = Math.max(img.width, img.height) || 1;
                const scale = Math.min(1, maxSide / longest);
                const targetW = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.width * scale));
                const targetH = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.height * scale));
                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                canvas.width = targetW;
                canvas.height = targetH;
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                if (!ctx) return reject(new Error('canvas_failed'));
                ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, targetW, targetH);

                const getSize = (s) => Math.ceil((s.split(',')[1] || '').length * 3 / 4);
                let out = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
                while (getSize(out) > maxBytes && quality > minQuality) {
                    quality = Math.max(minQuality, quality - 0.1);
                    out = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
                }
                resolve(out);
            };
            img.src = String(reader.result || '');
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
}

/**
 * @param {string} str
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function escapeHtml(str) {
    if (!str) return ''
    // Each entity is written with a \u0026 escape on purpose. This file's TEXT rides into the
    // exported document inside <script>, and TavernHelper hands that document to the iframe as a
    // `srcdoc` ATTRIBUTE, whose value the HTML parser entity-decodes ONCE. A literal ampersand
    // entity therefore reaches the JS parser already decoded — the double-quoted one collapses to
    // three quote characters in a row and kills the whole module, menu included. The escape holds
    // no ampersand for that parser to find and builds the identical string at runtime.
    return str.replace(/&/g, "\u0026amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "\u0026lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "\u0026gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "\u0026quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "\u0026#39;")
}

// THIS side — at bake, at pack export and again at click — never at the far end, which normalises
// args and cannot tell a prototype key from an honest one.

// The dispatcher's own rule for an action name (mvu-helper readMenuActionRequest): ONE plain
// segment, because the engine surface is addressed as actions.<name> and a dot would reach past it.
const ACTION_NAME_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_$-]+$/

// Written by the renderer at click time — the dotted path of the block item the button sits in ('' at
// root), the same observation the formatter lane sends. An author's value here would be overwritten.
export const RESERVED_ACTION_ARG_KEYS = ['scopePath']
const PROTOTYPE_KEYS = ['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']

/**
 * '' when `name` is a plain action name; otherwise why not.
 * @param {unknown} name
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function actionNameProblem(name) {
    if (typeof name !== 'string' || !name.trim()) return 'names no action'
    if (!ACTION_NAME_RE.test(name)) return 'action name ' + JSON.stringify(name) + ' is not a plain name (letters, digits, _ $ -)'
    return ''
}

/**
 * '' when `args` is a plain JSON object the dispatcher may receive; otherwise why not.
 * @param {unknown} args
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function actionArgsProblem(args) {
    if (args === undefined) return ''
    if (!args || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)) return 'args must be a JSON object'
    for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
        if (RESERVED_ACTION_ARG_KEYS.includes(key)) return 'args.' + key + ' is reserved — the renderer sets it at click time'
    }
    return jsonValueProblem(args, 'args')
}

function jsonValueProblem(value, at) {
    if (value === null) return ''
    const kind = typeof value
    if (kind === 'string' || kind === 'boolean') return ''
    if (kind === 'number') return Number.isFinite(value) ? '' : at + ' is not a finite number'
    if (kind !== 'object') return at + ' is a ' + kind + ' — args carry plain JSON only'
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
            const problem = jsonValueProblem(value[i], at + '[' + i + ']')
            if (problem) return problem
        }
        return ''
    }
    const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
    if (proto !== Object.prototype && proto !== null) return at + ' is not a plain object'
    for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
        if (PROTOTYPE_KEYS.includes(key)) return at + '.' + key + ' is a prototype key'
        const problem = jsonValueProblem(value[key], at + '.' + key)
        if (problem) return problem
    }
    return ''
}

// ── row actions (D8) — the verbs a list cell puts on every row ────────────────
// Declared, never hardcoded in a template: `[{ title, action, args?, confirm? }]`. `title` is the
// button's label, `action` an engine export under the name rule above, `args` static JSON riding
// under the row's own observations (listPath, itemKey), `confirm` presentation — true for a generic
// "<title> "<key>"?" or the question text with `{itemKey}` substituted. What a verb NEEDS from the
// player is deliberately NOT declared here: the engine answers that at click time (inputs.<name>),
// so the layout says WHICH verbs and never WHAT they take.
const ROW_ACTION_FIELDS = ['title', 'action', 'args', 'confirm']

/**
 * '' when `list` is a row-action declaration the renderer may draw; otherwise why not.
 * @param {unknown} list
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function rowActionsProblem(list) {
    if (list === undefined) return ''
    if (!Array.isArray(list)) return 'rowActions must be an array'
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
        const at = 'rowActions[' + i + ']'
        const entry = list[i]
        if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object' || Array.isArray(entry)) return at + ' is not an object'
        if (typeof entry.title !== 'string' || !entry.title.trim()) return at + ' has no title — the button needs a label'
        const nameProblem = actionNameProblem(entry.action)
        if (nameProblem) return at + ' ' + nameProblem
        const argsProblem = actionArgsProblem(entry.args)
        if (argsProblem) return at + ' ' + argsProblem
        if (entry.confirm !== undefined && typeof entry.confirm !== 'boolean' && typeof entry.confirm !== 'string') {
            return at + ' confirm must be true/false or the question text'
        }
        for (const key of Object.keys(entry)) {
            if (!ROW_ACTION_FIELDS.includes(key)) return at + ' has an unknown field "' + key + '" (' + ROW_ACTION_FIELDS.join(', ') + ')'
        }
    }
    return ''
}

/**
 * A JSON value as it rides in an attribute (a button's args, a list cell's args, its row actions):
 * every character that could close the quote, open a tag or form an entity written as a JSON \u escape. MEASURED 2026-08-28: the exported
 * document is entity-decoded ONCE on its way into the message iframe (the regex's lt-entity `<br>`
 * arrives as a real tag, and not one quot-entity survives), so a double-quoted attribute holding an
 * escaped quote would break at exactly the moment it is read. A \u escape holds no ampersand and
 * survives that decode unchanged.
 * @param {unknown} args
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function encodeJsonAttribute(args) {
    return JSON.stringify(args || {})
        .replace(/</g, '\\u003c')
        .replace(/>/g, '\\u003e')
        .replace(/&/g, '\\u0026')
        .replace(/'/g, '\\u0027')
}

/**
 * @param {CardConfig} card
 * @param {string} [blockKey]
 * @param {string} [absolutePrefix]
 * @param {LocaleAccumulator} locale
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function generateCardHtml(card, blockKey = '', absolutePrefix = '', locale) {
    const localeKey = locale.register('lbl_' + card.type.toLowerCase(), card.id, card.title || '')

    // Helper to get relative path for binding (may be relative inside blocks)
    const getBindPath = (key) => {
        if (!key) return ''
        if (!blockKey) return key
        // If key already starts with blockKey, OR contains a dot (absolute path), use it as is
        if (key.startsWith(blockKey) || key.includes('.')) return key
        return `${blockKey}.${key}`
    }

    // Helper to get ABSOLUTE full path for mutations (delete, edit)
    // Uses originalMappedKey preserved by makeRelative, or builds from absolutePrefix
    const getFullPath = (key) => {
        // First check if card has originalMappedKey (preserved before makeRelative stripped prefix)
        const originalKey = card.originalMappedKey;
        if (originalKey) return originalKey;
        // Otherwise, use absolutePrefix if available
        if (!key) return '';
        if (absolutePrefix && key && !key.includes('.')) {
            return `${absolutePrefix}.${key}`;
        }
        return key;
    }

    // Pack layouts name formatters per cell (B1's lift); the attribute is how the runtime finds the
    // element to fill from the resolved map. Field follows the cell shape, same rule as the exporter.
    const getFmtAttr = () => {
        const map = card.formatters
        if (!map || typeof map !== 'object' || Array.isArray(map)) return ''
        const field = card.sourceType === 'lorebook' ? 'lorebookKey' : (card.type === 'Image' ? 'image' : 'text')
        const name = map[field]
        if (typeof name !== 'string' || !name.trim()) return ''
        const attr = field === 'lorebookKey' ? 'data-fmt-lb' : (field === 'image' ? 'data-fmt-img' : 'data-fmt-text')
        return ` ${attr}="${escapeHtml(name.trim())}"`
    }

    // Advanced Logic's FIXED value. The export turns a body that only assigns a literal into
    // `staticValue` (statusmenu-pack-export.js liftCustomLogic). It is the cell's _output, so it owns
    // the cell exactly as a computed body's formatter result does, and the mapped variable never
    // overwrites it: an Image shows it as its src, a lorebook cell looks it up as the key, and a
    // StatRow or RichText draws it as HTML.
    const hasFixedValue = typeof card.staticValue === 'string'
    // No source at all. A cell mapped to its block itself also arrives with mappedKey '' (makeRelative's
    // "bind to self"), and only its original key tells the two apart. Binding an empty path reads the
    // whole scope object, which a cell draws as "[object Object]".
    const isUnmapped = !card.mappedKey && !card.originalMappedKey

    let innerFn = ''
    switch (card.type) {
        case 'StatRow':
            if (card.sourceType === 'lorebook') {
                innerFn = `
                <div class="prop-row">
                    <span class="prop-label" id="${localeKey}">${escapeHtml(card.title)}</span>
                    <div class="prop-val-container">
                        <span class="prop-val" ${getFmtAttr()} data-lb-key="${escapeHtml(hasFixedValue ? card.staticValue : (card.lorebookKey || ''))}">Loading...</span>
                    </div>
                </div>`
            } else {
                const valueHtml = hasFixedValue
                    ? `<span class="prop-val" ${getFmtAttr()}>${card.staticValue}</span>`
                    : (isUnmapped
                        ? `<span class="prop-val" ${getFmtAttr()}>???</span>`
                        : `<span class="prop-val" ${getFmtAttr()} data-bind-val="${getBindPath(card.mappedKey)}">???</span>`)
                innerFn = `
                <div class="prop-row" data-bind-fullpath="${getFullPath(card.mappedKey)}">
                    <span class="prop-label" id="${localeKey}" ${!card.title ? `data-bind-label="${getBindPath(card.mappedKey)}"` : ''}>${escapeHtml(card.title)}</span>
                    <div class="prop-val-container">
                        ${valueHtml}
                    </div>
                </div>`
            }
            break
        case 'StatBar':
            innerFn = `
                <div class="stat-bar-box" data-bind-fullpath="${getFullPath(card.mappedKey)}">
                    <div class="stat-bar-header">
                        <span class="stat-bar-label" id="${localeKey}" ${!card.title ? `data-bind-label="${getBindPath(card.mappedKey)}"` : ''}>${escapeHtml(card.title)}</span>
                        <span class="stat-bar-val"><span data-bind-curr="${getBindPath(card.mappedKey)}">?</span> / <span data-bind-max="${getBindPath(card.maxMappedKey)}">?</span></span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-bar-track">
                        <div class="stat-bar-fill bar-${card.barColor || 'default'}" style="width:50%;" data-bind-bar="${getBindPath(card.mappedKey)}"${card.maxMappedKey ? ` data-bind-bar-max="${getBindPath(card.maxMappedKey)}"` : ''}></div>
                    </div>
                </div>`
            break
        case 'Image':
              const imgTitle = card.title || 'Avatar'
              const imgLocaleKey = locale.register('lbl_img', card.id, imgTitle)

              if (card.sourceType === 'lorebook') {
                  // Lorebook Logic
                  const lbKey = hasFixedValue ? card.staticValue : (card.lorebookKey || '')
                  innerFn = `
                    <div class="img-wrapper" style="text-align:center;">
                        <img 
                            src="" 
                            alt="${escapeHtml(imgTitle)}" 
                            id="${imgLocaleKey}"
                            class="avatar-img" 
                            style="width:${card.imageScale || 100}%; max-width:100%; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid var(--accent-primary); cursor:pointer; min-height:50px;" 
                            ${getFmtAttr()}
                            data-lb-key="${escapeHtml(lbKey)}"
                            onclick="showImagePopup(this.src)"
                        />
                         <!-- No Edit Button for Lorebook Images (Managed in Builder) -->
                    </div>`
              } else if (hasFixedValue || isUnmapped) {
                  // A fixed image, or none at all: nothing to bind, and nothing for ✎ to save to.
                  const fixedSrc = hasFixedValue && card.staticValue ? escapeHtml(card.staticValue) : noImageSrc()
                  innerFn = `
                    <div style="text-align:center;">
                        <div class="img-wrapper" style="text-align:center; position:relative; display:inline-block; width:${card.imageScale || 100}%; max-width:100%;">
                            <img
                                src="${fixedSrc}"
                                alt="${escapeHtml(imgTitle)}"
                                id="${imgLocaleKey}"
                                class="avatar-img"
                                style="width:100%; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid var(--accent-primary); cursor:pointer; display:block;"${getFmtAttr()}
                                onclick="showImagePopup(this.src)"
                            />
                        </div>
                    </div>`
              } else {
                  // Variable Logic (Default)
                  const relImgPath = getBindPath(card.mappedKey);
                  const fullImgPath = getFullPath(card.mappedKey);
                  innerFn = `
                    <div class="img-wrapper" style="text-align:center; position:relative; display:inline-block; width:${card.imageScale || 100}%; max-width:100%;" data-bind-fullpath="${fullImgPath}">
                        <img 
                            src="" 
                            alt="${escapeHtml(imgTitle)}" 
                            id="${imgLocaleKey}"
                            class="avatar-img" 
                            style="width:100%; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid var(--accent-primary); cursor:pointer; display:block;"${getFmtAttr()} 
                            data-bind-img="${relImgPath}" 
                            onclick="showImagePopup(this.src)"
                        />
                        <!-- Edit Button -->
                        <div class="img-edit-btn" 
                            data-save-root="${absolutePrefix}" 
                            data-save-leaf="${relImgPath}"
                            onclick="handleEditClick(event, this)"
                        >
                            ✎
                        </div>
                    </div>`
                  // Wrap in center alignment for column
                  innerFn = `<div style="text-align:center;">${innerFn}</div>`;
              }
              break
        case 'QuestList':
             // Generic List Container - uses mappedKey from builder config
             const listKey = getBindPath(card.mappedKey)
             // Use originalMappedKey (preserved before makeRelative stripped it) or fall back to building the full path
             const fullListPath = card.originalMappedKey || (absolutePrefix && card.mappedKey ? `${absolutePrefix}.${card.mappedKey}` : listKey);
             let listType = card.listType || card.layoutMode || '';

             if (!listType) {
                 listType = 'simple';
             }

             // Normalize 'list' to 'simple'
             if (listType === 'list') listType = 'simple';

             // Handle custom templates: emit custom-{name} as list type
             if (listType === 'custom' && card.customTemplateName) {
                 listType = `custom-${card.customTemplateName.trim()}`;
             } else if (listType === 'custom') {
                 listType = 'simple'; // Fallback if no name provided
             }

             const listId = `list-${card.id}`
             const allowEditAttr = card.allowEdit ? ' data-allow-edit="1"' : ''
             const allowDeleteAttr = card.allowDelete ? ' data-allow-delete="1"' : ''
             // A list cell's `args` ride every action its rows post (delete, edit, equip, unequip),
             // under the click's own keys — the layout's way to name a relation only it knows, such as
             // the inventory an equipment list returns items to. Same rules as a button's args.
             const listArgsAttr = (card.args !== undefined && !actionArgsProblem(card.args)) ? ` data-args='${encodeJsonAttribute(card.args)}'` : ''
             // The verbs every row offers (D8). A bad declaration bakes nothing: the export refuses it
             // by cell path, and a half-drawn row would only hide that.
             const rowActionsAttr = (Array.isArray(card.rowActions) && card.rowActions.length && !rowActionsProblem(card.rowActions)) ? ` data-row-actions='${encodeJsonAttribute(card.rowActions)}'` : ''
             const listDiv = `<div id="${listId}" class="simple-list" data-bind-list="${listKey}" data-bind-list-fullpath="${fullListPath}" data-list-type="${listType}"${allowEditAttr}${allowDeleteAttr}${listArgsAttr}${rowActionsAttr}></div>`

             const startCollapsed = card.collapsed
             innerFn = `
                <div class="list-collapse-wrapper">
                    <div class="nested-section-header list-collapse-header" data-target="${listId}" style="cursor:pointer; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
                        <span>${escapeHtml(card.title || '')}</span><span class="list-collapse-arrow" style="font-size:0.8em; opacity:0.6;">${startCollapsed ? '▶' : '▼'}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="list-collapse-body"${startCollapsed ? ' style="display:none;"' : ''}>
                        ${listDiv}
                    </div>
                </div>`
             break
        case 'RichText':
             // .nested-section-header, as the preview draws it. Its text is HTML there (v-html), so it
             // is HTML here too — the title, or Advanced Logic's fixed value.
             if (card.sourceType === 'lorebook') {
                 const rtKey = locale.register('lbl_rt', card.id, 'Loading...')
                 const rtLoreKey = hasFixedValue ? card.staticValue : (card.lorebookKey || '')
                 innerFn = `<div class="nested-section-header" id="${rtKey}" ${getFmtAttr()} data-lb-key="${escapeHtml(rtLoreKey)}">Loading...</div>`
             } else {
                 const rtText = hasFixedValue ? card.staticValue : (card.title || 'RichText')
                 const rtKey = locale.register('lbl_rt', card.id, rtText)
                 const rtBind = hasFixedValue ? '' : getBindPath(card.mappedKey)
                 const rtFullPath = getFullPath(card.mappedKey)
                 innerFn = `<div class="nested-section-header" id="${rtKey}" ${getFmtAttr()} ${rtBind ? `data-bind-val="${rtBind}" data-bind-fullpath="${rtFullPath}"` : ''}>${rtText}</div>`
             }
             break
        case 'GridContainer':
             const subCards = card.cards?.map(c => {
                 const cw = c.width || (c.type === 'GridContainer' || c.type === 'QuestList' ? 100 : 50)
                 return `<div class="prop-row-wrapper" style="width:${cw}%">${generateCardHtml(c, blockKey, absolutePrefix, locale)}</div>`
             }).join('') || ''
             const gcKey = locale.register('lbl_gc', card.id, card.title || '')
             innerFn = `
                <div class="grid-group-card">
                    ${card.title ? `<div class="grid-group-header" id="${gcKey}">${escapeHtml(card.title)}</div>` : ''}
                    <div class="grid-group-content">${subCards}</div>
                </div>`
             break
        case 'Checkbox':
             // For Checkboxes, we need to defer path construction to runtime (renderBlock)
             // because we need the Item Key (e.g. "Dog") which is only present during iteration.
             const relativeBindPath = getBindPath(card.mappedKey);
             const checkboxFullPath = getFullPath(card.mappedKey);
             // A read-only box shows the value and cannot be toggled: `disabled`, and no save attributes, so
             // the runtime wires no write for it (rt_bindings attaches its setValue click only to a box that
             // names where it saves).
             const checkboxWrite = card.isReadOnly
                 ? 'disabled'
                 : `data-save-root="${absolutePrefix}" data-save-leaf="${relativeBindPath}"`;
             // Keep checkbox layout aligned with the standard row contract used by other fields:
             // left label + right control, with wrap support so long labels remain visible.
             innerFn = `
                <div class="prop-row kin-checkbox-row" data-bind-fullpath="${checkboxFullPath}">
                    <span class="kin-checkbox-text" id="${localeKey}">${escapeHtml(card.title)}</span>
                    <div class="prop-val-container kin-checkbox-control">
                        <input 
                            type="checkbox"
                            class="ar-checkbox-input"
                            style="margin:0; flex-shrink:0;"
                            data-bind-checked="${relativeBindPath}" 
                            ${checkboxWrite}
                        />
                    </div>
                </div>`
            break
        case 'ActionButton': {
            const problem = actionNameProblem(card.action) || actionArgsProblem(card.args)
            if (problem) {
                // Obviously wrong beats silently missing (§B.6): the pack lane REFUSES at export, and
                // the throwaway HTML lane shows the reason where the button would have been.
                innerFn = `<div class="unknown-card">[ActionButton: ${escapeHtml(problem)}]</div>`
                break
            }
            // The look is the sheet's (`.menu-action-btn` in the project's Global CSS); the runtime stamps
            // the class and the action contract only.
            const actionLocaleKey = locale.register('lbl_actionbutton', card.id, card.title || card.action)
            innerFn = `
                <div class="prop-row action-row">
                    <button type="button" class="menu-action-btn" id="${actionLocaleKey}" data-action="${card.action}" data-args='${encodeJsonAttribute(card.args)}'>${escapeHtml(card.title || card.action)}</button>
                </div>`
            break
        }
        default:
            innerFn = `<div class="unknown-card">[${card.type}]</div>`
    }

    return innerFn
}

// ── Block HTML ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * @param {BlockConfig} block
 * @param {LocaleAccumulator} locale
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function generateBlockHtml(block, locale) {
    const width = block.width || 100
    const blockKey = block.mappedKey || ''
    // Register Block Title
    const blkKey = locale.register('lbl_blk', block.id, block.title)

    // If mappedKey is present, we generate a TEMPLATE for client-side rendering
    if (blockKey) {
        // IMPORTANT: Inside the template, bindings must be relative to the Item.

        // Helper to clone and strip prefixes (preserves original path for fullpath attributes)
        const makeRelative = (c) => {
            const copy = { ...c };

            // Preserve the ORIGINAL full path for ALL cards before stripping (used for data-bind-fullpath)
            if (c.mappedKey) {
                copy.originalMappedKey = c.mappedKey;
            }
            if (c.maxMappedKey) {
                copy.originalMaxMappedKey = c.maxMappedKey;
            }

            if (copy.mappedKey && copy.mappedKey.startsWith(blockKey + '.')) {
                copy.mappedKey = copy.mappedKey.substring(blockKey.length + 1);
            } else if (copy.mappedKey === blockKey) {
                copy.mappedKey = ''; // Bind to self
            }

            if (copy.maxMappedKey && copy.maxMappedKey.startsWith(blockKey + '.')) {
                 copy.maxMappedKey = copy.maxMappedKey.substring(blockKey.length + 1);
            }

            if (copy.cards) {
                copy.cards = copy.cards.map(makeRelative);
            }
            return copy;
        };

        const cardHtml = block.cards.map(c => {
            const relCard = makeRelative(c);
            const cWidth = c.width || (c.type === 'GridContainer' || c.type === 'QuestList' ? 100 : 50)
            // Pass '' as blockKeyContext so bindings remain relative
            // Pass blockKey as absolutePrefix so onclick handlers can construct full path
            return `
            <div class="prop-row-wrapper" style="width:${cWidth}%">
                ${generateCardHtml(relCard, '', blockKey, locale)} 
            </div>`
        }).join('')

        const templateId = `tpl-blk-${block.id}`
        const containerId = `blk-${block.id}`

        return `
        <div class="col-wrapper" style="width:${width}%">
            <div class="info-card" style="${block.scale ? `font-size:${block.scale}em;` : ''}">
                <div class="card-header" id="${blkKey}">${escapeHtml(block.title)}</div>
                
                <!-- Container for Dynamic Content -->
                <div id="${containerId}" class="prop-list" data-bind-root="${blockKey}" data-template="${templateId}" data-page-size="${block.pageSize || 5}"${block.showQuickJump ? ' data-quick-jump="1"' : ''}>
                    <!-- Content will be injected here -->
                </div>

                <!-- Template -->
                <template id="${templateId}">
                    ${cardHtml}
                </template>
            </div>
        </div>`
    }

    const cardHtml = block.cards.map(c => {
        const cWidth = c.width || (c.type === 'GridContainer' || c.type === 'QuestList' ? 100 : 50)
        return `
        <div class="prop-row-wrapper" style="width:${cWidth}%">
            ${generateCardHtml(c, blockKey, '', locale)}
        </div>`
    }).join('')

    // If Unmapped (No List), render cards DIRECTLY.
    if (!block.mappedKey) {
        return `
        <div class="col-wrapper" style="width:${width}%">
            <div class="info-card" style="${block.scale ? `font-size:${block.scale}em;` : ''}">
                <div class="card-header" id="${blkKey}">${escapeHtml(block.title)}</div>
                <div class="prop-list">
                    ${cardHtml}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>`
    }

    const templateId = `tpl-blk-${block.id}`
    const containerId = `blk-${block.id}`

    return `
    <div class="col-wrapper" style="width:${width}%">
        <div class="info-card" style="${block.scale ? `font-size:${block.scale}em;` : ''}">
            <div class="card-header" id="${blkKey}">${escapeHtml(block.title)}</div>
            
            <!-- Container for Dynamic Content -->
            <div id="${containerId}" class="prop-list" data-bind-root="${blockKey}" data-template="${templateId}" data-page-size="${block.pageSize || 5}"${block.showQuickJump ? ' data-quick-jump="1"' : ''}>
                <!-- Content will be injected here -->
            </div>

            <!-- Template -->
            <template id="${templateId}">
                ${cardHtml}
            </template>
        </div>
    </div>`
}

/**
 * @param {TabConfig} tab
 * @param {number} index
 * @param {LocaleAccumulator} locale
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function generateTabHtml(tab, index, locale) {
    const activeClass = index === 0 ? 'active' : ''
    const blocksHtml = tab.blocks.map(b => generateBlockHtml(b, locale)).join('')

    return `
    <div id="tab-${tab.id}" class="tab-content ${activeClass}">
        <div class="grid-row">
            ${blocksHtml}
        </div>
    </div>`
}

// ── Templates HTML ────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * @param {{ name: string, html: string }[]} customTemplatesList
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function generateTemplates(customTemplatesList) {
    return `
    <!-- Every built-in template carries ONE slot for row verbs and no verb of its own (D8): the

// The card's own layout stays BAKED. This part adds tabs from an INSTALLED StatusMenu Pack: at menu
// init it reads the pack registry and the pack's layout entry from the lorebook, renders the
// declaration's tabs through the same generators the export was baked with, and appends them to the
// tab nav — a pack tab appears with zero card rebuild, and disappears the render after its entry is
// removed.
//
// Formatter-driven cells resolve through mvu-helper: THIS side owns the request walker (which cells
// exist, and what `stat` means for each — a cell inside a collection resolves per ITEM, the item
// identity riding in its cell id), mvu-helper resolves the declared scope paths and routes ONE
// Worker batch per stat update. Values render synchronously from the returned map; a formatter that
// does not answer leaves its cell showing the raw binding (warn lane, never a refusal).
//
// Carries `export` for its pure decision functions — legal and inert inside the exported document's
// single <script type="module">, and what lets node run them (tools/test-pack-layout.mjs), exactly
// like rt_htmlGenerators.js.

// The wire to mvu-helper's dispatcher. PUBLISHED — the contract is mvu-helper's
// `plans/executed/gamelogic-pack-v2.md` §9a, and this runtime is one client of it, not its owner.
// The cross-repo test pins all THREE spellings (that doc, mvu-helper's constant, this one).
export const PACK_FORMATTER_MESSAGE = 'mvu-helper:statusmenu-formatters';

// The two lorebook entry comments this runtime READS. mvu-helper WRITES them — `menuRegistryComment()`
// and `menuLayoutComment(id)` in its statusmenu-pack-core.js — and neither repo can import the other,
// so the spelling is restated here and pinned byte-identical by the cross-repo test, the same
// discipline the wire constant above gets and for the same reason: a second spelling of a published
// name is a second thing that can drift, and a drifted needle finds no entry, so the menu draws an
// empty frame reporting `packs found=1 rendered=0 skipped=1` rather than failing (live, ArtificKoi,
// 2026-09-04, when the layout needle was renamed on the writer side alone).
//
// Both sides lower-case before matching, so case is not part of the contract — the spelling is. And
// the spelling is frozen by every menu already exported: this file is built INTO the card's regex,
// so a rename needs a builder release AND a re-export of every shell, never a tidiness pass.
export const PACK_REGISTRY_NEEDLE = '[StatusMenuPack:Registry]';
export function packLayoutNeedle(packId) {
    return '[StatusMenuPack:' + packId + '] (Layout)';
}

// The renderer sets this part draws. A declaration naming any other kind renders a FALLBACK tab
// naming the kind (obviously wrong beats silently missing), never breaks the menu.
export const PACK_SUPPORTED_KINDS = ['tabbed-grid'];

// ── pure decisions (node-testable) ───────────────────────────────────────────

// The registry entry's content: '#'-comment lines, then JSON. Returns { activeMenuId } or null.
export function parsePackRegistryContent(text) {
    if (typeof text !== 'string' || !text.trim()) return null;
    const jsonText = text.split('\n').filter((l) => !l.trim().startsWith('#')).join('\n').trim();
    try {
        const obj = JSON.parse(jsonText);
        if (obj && typeof obj.activeMenuId === 'string' && obj.activeMenuId) return { activeMenuId: obj.activeMenuId };
        return null;
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[MZSMB][pack] the StatusMenu registry entry is not parseable JSON — no pack renders:', e.message);
        return null;
    }
}

// The layout entry's content: the renderer declaration object, installed whole.
export function parsePackLayoutContent(text) {
    if (typeof text !== 'string' || !text.trim()) return { ok: false, reason: 'the pack layout entry is missing or empty' };
    let declaration;
    try { declaration = JSON.parse(text); }
    catch (e) { return { ok: false, reason: 'the pack layout entry is not parseable JSON: ' + e.message }; }
    if (!declaration || typeof declaration !== 'object' || Array.isArray(declaration)) {
        return { ok: false, reason: 'the pack layout entry must be the renderer declaration object ({ kind, format, tabs, … })' };
    }
    return { ok: true, declaration };
}

// Every node of the declaration's tabs that carries executable text. The layout is 100% declarative,
// and a body in it means the lift was bypassed — the body belongs in the StatusMenu Engine as a named
// formatter, so a layout still carrying one would render a cell that silently answers nothing. The
// layout entry is hand-editable, so finding one refuses the whole pack: the render half of the
// customLogic fence.
export function findPackCustomLogic(tabs) {
    const sites = [];
    const walkCards = (cards, path) => {
        (cards || []).forEach((card, i) => {
            const here = path + '/cards/' + i;
            if (typeof card.customLogic === 'string' && card.customLogic.trim()) sites.push(here);
            if (Array.isArray(card.cards)) walkCards(card.cards, here);
        });
    };
    (tabs || []).forEach((tab, ti) => {
        (tab.blocks || []).forEach((block, bi) => {
            const here = '/tabs/' + ti + '/blocks/' + bi;
            if (typeof block.customLogic === 'string' && block.customLogic.trim()) sites.push(here);
            walkCards(block.cards, here);
        });
    });
    return sites;
}

// The one verdict: render, raw (unknown kind — fallback tab), or refuse (executable text found).
export function packRenderDecision(declaration, supportedKinds) {
    const kind = declaration && declaration.kind;
    if (typeof kind !== 'string' || !kind) {
        return { mode: 'raw', reason: 'the declaration names no "kind" — nothing says which renderer draws it' };
    }
    if (!(supportedKinds || []).includes(kind)) {
        return { mode: 'raw', reason: 'unknown layout kind "' + kind + '" — this menu renders ' + (supportedKinds || []).join('/') + ' only' };
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(declaration.tabs) || !declaration.tabs.length) {
        return { mode: 'raw', reason: 'the declaration carries no tabs' };
    }
    const logicSites = findPackCustomLogic(declaration.tabs);
    if (logicSites.length) {
        return { mode: 'refuse', reason: 'the layout carries customLogic at ' + logicSites.join(', ') + ' — a pack layout is 100% declarative, and a body here would execute' };
    }
    return { mode: 'render', reason: '' };
}

// Prefix every id in the pack's tabs so nothing collides with the card's own DOM: the card and the
// pack both legitimately own a "tab-1", and tab/block/card ids ride element ids, template ids and
// the block pager's state keys.
export function namespacePackTabs(tabs, packId) {
    const prefix = 'pk-' + String(packId || 'pack') + '-';
    const nsCards = (cards) => (cards || []).map((c) => {
        const copy = { ...c, id: prefix + String(c.id || '') };
        if (Array.isArray(c.cards)) copy.cards = nsCards(c.cards);
        return copy;
    });
    return (tabs || []).map((t) => ({
        ...t,
        id: prefix + String(t.id || ''),
        blocks: (t.blocks || []).map((b) => ({ ...b, id: prefix + String(b.id || ''), cards: nsCards(b.cards) })),
    }));
}

// Which tab to activate once the pack's tabs are appended: the first pack tab, but ONLY when the
// document has no active tab. The production regex is a SHELL — runtime + nav, zero baked tabs
// (pack-authoring-plan §B.7d) — and without this it would sit blank until a click. A baked first tab,
// where one exists, stays the active one.
export function packTabToActivate(hasActiveTab, tabs) {
    if (hasActiveTab || !Array.isArray(tabs) || !tabs.length) return '';
    return 'tab-' + String(tabs[0].id);
}

// renderBlock's own item rule, restated: which children of a collection value are ITEMS.
export function packEnumerateItems(value) {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return [];
    return Object.entries(value)
        .filter(([k, v]) => k !== '$meta' && k !== '$key' && k !== 'template' && v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v))
        .map(([k]) => k);
}

// U+0001 joins every composite key — no path, name or field can contain it, so no two keys can
// forge each other. The HOST joins its reply-map keys with the same character.
export const PACK_KEY_SEP = String.fromCharCode(1);

export function packFormatterValueKey(formatterName, scopePath) {
    return String(formatterName) + PACK_KEY_SEP + String(scopePath || '');
}

// THE WALKER — B2's half of the pre-pass seam. Walks the pack's tabs against the CURRENT state and
// plans one request per formatter per scope:
//   • cell in an unmapped block            → scopePath ''            (stat = the whole state)
//   • cell in a mapped, non-collection block → scopePath = blockKey  (stat = that object)
//   • cell in a mapped COLLECTION block    → one request PER ITEM, scopePath = blockKey.itemKey
// Identical (formatter, scope) pairs dedupe to one request. The host resolves the paths and routes
// the calls; it reads no layout structure — this list is the only thing that crosses.
export function planPackFormatterRequests(tabs, statData, collectionPaths) {
    const has = (k) => !!collectionPaths && (collectionPaths.has(k) || collectionPaths.has('.' + k));
    const seen = new Set();
    const requests = [];
    const add = (formatterName, field, scopePath) => {
        const key = packFormatterValueKey(formatterName, scopePath) + PACK_KEY_SEP + field;
        if (seen.has(key)) return;
        seen.add(key);
        requests.push({ cellId: 'f:' + formatterName + '@' + (scopePath || 'root'), field, formatterName, scopePath });
    };
    const readPath = (obj, path) => {
        let cur = obj;
        for (const seg of String(path || '').split('.')) {
            if (!seg) return cur;
            if (cur === null || cur === undefined || typeof cur !== 'object') return undefined;
            cur = cur[seg];
        }
        return cur;
    };
    const walkCards = (cards, scopes) => {
        (cards || []).forEach((card) => {
            const map = card.formatters;
            if (map && typeof map === 'object' && !Array.isArray(map)) {
                for (const [field, name] of Object.entries(map)) {
                    if (typeof name !== 'string' || !name.trim()) continue;
                    for (const scopePath of scopes) add(name.trim(), field, scopePath);
                }
            }
            if (Array.isArray(card.cards)) walkCards(card.cards, scopes);
        });
    };
    (tabs || []).forEach((tab) => {
        (tab.blocks || []).forEach((block) => {
            const blockKey = String(block.mappedKey || '');
            let scopes;
            if (!blockKey) scopes = [''];
            else if (has(blockKey)) {
                scopes = packEnumerateItems(readPath(statData, blockKey)).map((k) => blockKey + '.' + k);
                if (!scopes.length) return;               // no items — nothing to resolve for this block
            } else scopes = [blockKey];
            walkCards(block.cards, scopes);
        });
    });
    return requests;
}

const _packState = { rendered: false, id: '', tabs: null };
const _packFormatterValues = new Map();   // packFormatterValueKey(name, scope) → rendered string
let _packRpcSeq = 0;
let _packRpcWarned = false;

// ── the wire (one message per stat update) ───────────────────────────────────

function postPackFormatterBatch(requests) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const requestId = 'pf-' + (++_packRpcSeq);
        const onMessage = (event) => {
            const d = event && event.data;
            if (!d || d.type !== PACK_FORMATTER_MESSAGE + '-result' || d.requestId !== requestId) return;
            cleanup();
            resolve(d);
        };
        const timer = setTimeout(() => { cleanup(); resolve(null); }, 4000);
        const cleanup = () => { clearTimeout(timer); window.removeEventListener('message', onMessage); };
        window.addEventListener('message', onMessage);
        try {
            window.top.postMessage({ type: PACK_FORMATTER_MESSAGE, requestId, requests }, '*');
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[MZSMB][pack] could not reach the host page for the formatter batch:', e.message);
            cleanup();
            resolve(null);
        }
    });
}

// Called by updateStatusPanel BEFORE the render pass (§9.5 ordering: collect, ONE call, then render
// synchronously from resolved values). No pack, or a pack with no formatter cells, costs nothing.
async function resolvePackFormatters(statData) {
    if (!_packState.rendered || !_packState.tabs) return;
    const requests = planPackFormatterRequests(_packState.tabs, statData, COLLECTION_PATHS);
    if (!requests.length) return;
    const reply = await postPackFormatterBatch(requests);
    if (!reply || !reply.map) {
        if (!_packRpcWarned) {
            _packRpcWarned = true;
            console.warn('[MZSMB][pack] mvu-helper did not answer the formatter batch (' + requests.length
                + ' request(s)) — formatter cells keep their raw values. Is the extension installed and up to date?');
        }
        return;
    }
    _packRpcWarned = false;
    for (const r of requests) {
        const value = reply.map[r.cellId + PACK_KEY_SEP + r.field];
        if (value !== undefined) _packFormatterValues.set(packFormatterValueKey(r.formatterName, r.scopePath), String(value));
    }
    // A formatter that did not answer keeps its old value out of the map, so its cell falls back to
    // the raw binding — the host already warned once per name.
}

// The scope an element sits in, read off the DOM: the enclosing data-bind-root container plus the
// per-item data-item-key stamp, so a cloned collection row resolves to ITS item; '' outside a block.
// ONE observation shared by the formatter fill below and the action caller (rt_menuAction.js).
export function packScopeOf(el) {
    const container = el && el.closest ? el.closest('[data-bind-root]') : null;
    const rootKey = container ? (container.getAttribute('data-bind-root') || '') : '';
    if (!rootKey) return '';
    const itemWrap = el.closest ? el.closest('[data-item-key]') : null;
    const itemKey = itemWrap ? itemWrap.getAttribute('data-item-key') : null;
    return itemKey ? rootKey + '.' + itemKey : rootKey;
}

// Called at the tail of updateBindingsIn for EVERY render pass, card and pack alike. A key with no
// value leaves the cell alone (raw).
function applyPackFormatterValues(root) {
    if (!_packFormatterValues.size || !root || typeof root.querySelectorAll !== 'function') return;
    const scopeOf = packScopeOf;
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-fmt-text]').forEach((el) => {
        const value = _packFormatterValues.get(packFormatterValueKey(el.getAttribute('data-fmt-text'), scopeOf(el)));
        if (value !== undefined && el.innerHTML !== value) el.innerHTML = value;
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-fmt-img]').forEach((el) => {
        const value = _packFormatterValues.get(packFormatterValueKey(el.getAttribute('data-fmt-img'), scopeOf(el)));
        if (value !== undefined && el.src !== value) el.src = value;
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-fmt-lb]').forEach((el) => {
        const value = _packFormatterValues.get(packFormatterValueKey(el.getAttribute('data-fmt-lb'), scopeOf(el)));
        if (value !== undefined && el.getAttribute('data-lb-key') !== value) el.setAttribute('data-lb-key', value);
    });
}

function appendPackFallbackTab(packId, reason) {
    const nav = document.querySelector('.tab-nav');
    const container = document.querySelector('.status-container');
    if (!nav || !container) return;

    btn.setAttribute('data-pack', packId);
    btn.setAttribute('onclick', "selectTab('" + tabId + "', this)");

    nav.appendChild(btn);

    tab.id = tabId;
    tab.className = 'tab-content';
    tab.setAttribute('data-pack', packId);

        + '" cannot be drawn by this menu: ' + reason + '</div>';
