async function initPackLayout() {
    const registryText = await fetchLorebookContent(PACK_REGISTRY_NEEDLE);
    const registry = parsePackRegistryContent(registryText);
    if (!registry) {
        console.log('[MZSMB][pack] packs found=0 rendered=0 — no StatusMenu Pack is installed on this card');
        return;
    }
    const packId = registry.activeMenuId;
    const layoutText = await fetchLorebookContent(packLayoutNeedle(packId));
    const parsed = parsePackLayoutContent(layoutText);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
        console.warn('[MZSMB][pack] packs found=1 (' + packId + ') rendered=0 skipped=1 — ' + parsed.reason);
        return;
    }
    const declaration = parsed.declaration;
    const decision = packRenderDecision(declaration, PACK_SUPPORTED_KINDS);
    if (decision.mode === 'refuse') {
        console.warn('[MZSMB][pack] pack "' + packId + '" REFUSED, nothing rendered — ' + decision.reason);
        return;
    }
    if (decision.mode === 'raw') {
        console.warn('[MZSMB][pack] pack "' + packId + '" renders as a fallback tab — ' + decision.reason);
        appendPackFallbackTab(packId, decision.reason);
        return;
    }

    const nav = document.querySelector('.tab-nav');
    const container = document.querySelector('.status-container');
    if (!nav || !container) {
        console.warn('[MZSMB][pack] pack "' + packId + '" found but this document has no tab nav to extend');
        return;
    }

    const tabs = namespacePackTabs(declaration.tabs, packId);

    // The pack's collection declarations must land BEFORE the first render — renderBlock's strict
    // mode reads this set to know a record map is a list.
    (declaration.collectionPaths || []).forEach((p) => COLLECTION_PATHS.add(String(p)));

    // Locale: the generation pass registers the pack DOM's own label keys (namespaced ids — no
    // collision with the card's). The pack's shipped statics are pack.<id>.-prefixed; they FILL
    // absent base keys and never overwrite the card's own.
    const locale = createLocaleAccumulator();
    const tabsHtml = tabs.map((t, i) => generateTabHtml(t, i + 1000, locale)).join('\n');
    locale.entries().forEach((val, key) => { if (LOCALE[key] === undefined) LOCALE[key] = val; });
    const foreignScopes = new Set();
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(declaration.staticLocale || {})) {
        const own = 'pack.' + packId + '.';
        const scoped = /^pack\.([^.]+)\./.exec(key);
        if (scoped && scoped[1] !== packId) foreignScopes.add(scoped[1]);
        const base = key.startsWith(own) ? key.slice(own.length) : key;
        if (LOCALE[base] === undefined) LOCALE[base] = val;
    }
    // A layout exported under another id: its locale keys never reach their base names (every
    // empty-list text reads "undefined") and its scoped CSS matches no element here. The export
    // tab's id has to be THIS pack's id; nothing on this side can repair that, so it is named.
    if (foreignScopes.size) {
        console.warn('[MZSMB][pack] ' + packId + ': the layout\'s locale is scoped to pack "' + [...foreignScopes].join('", "')
            + '" — it was exported under a different id; re-export it with id "' + packId + '"');
    }

    // CSS: the export lane scoped every rule under [data-pack="<id>"]; this side just carries it in.
    if (declaration.globalCss) {
        const style = document.createElement('style');
        style.id = 'pack-css-' + packId;
        style.textContent = declaration.globalCss;
        document.head.appendChild(style);
    }

    // The pack's own custom templates — skipped when the card already owns the name, and said so.
    for (const t of declaration.customTemplates || []) {
        const templateId = 'tmpl-custom-' + t.name;
        if (document.getElementById(templateId)) {
            console.warn('[MZSMB][pack] template "' + t.name + '" already exists in this card — the card\'s copy wins');
            continue;
        }
        const template = document.createElement('template');
        template.id = templateId;
        template.innerHTML = t.html || '';
        document.body.appendChild(template);
    }

    // The DOM: nav buttons + tab contents, each stamped data-pack so the scoped CSS reaches them.
    for (const t of tabs) {
        const btn = document.createElement('div');
        btn.className = 'tab-btn';
        btn.setAttribute('data-pack', packId);
        btn.setAttribute('onclick', "selectTab('tab-" + t.id + "', this)");
        btn.textContent = t.name || packId;
        nav.appendChild(btn);
    }
    const holder = document.createElement('div');
    holder.innerHTML = tabsHtml;
    Array.from(holder.children).forEach((el) => {
        el.setAttribute('data-pack', packId);
        el.classList.remove('active');                    // a baked first tab, where one exists, stays active
        container.appendChild(el);
    });
    const activateId = packTabToActivate(!!document.querySelector('.tab-content.active'), tabs);
    if (activateId) {
        const firstBtn = nav.querySelector('.tab-btn[data-pack="' + packId + '"]');
        if (firstBtn) selectTab(activateId, firstBtn);
    }

    _packState.rendered = true;
    _packState.id = packId;
    _packState.tabs = tabs;
    console.log('[MZSMB][pack] packs found=1 rendered=1 — "' + packId + '" (' + declaration.kind + '): '
        + tabs.length + ' tab(s), ' + (declaration.collectionPaths || []).length + ' collection path(s), css='
        + (declaration.globalCss ? declaration.globalCss.length + 'B' : 'none'));

    // The card rendered once before this ran — render again so pack cells populate now instead of
    // on the next stat event.
    if (_lastStatData) await updateStatusPanel({ stat_data: _lastStatData });
}

// The menu's WRITE lane, from the menu's side. Every write a player can make — a button, a checkbox,
// a row's delete, the detail form's save, a portrait change, equip/unequip — posts ONE {action, args}
// to mvu-helper's dispatcher on the main page; the dispatcher verifies the name against the installed
// StatusMenu Engine, runs the action in the Worker, applies the returned patches through the MVU rail
// and replies to THIS frame. Nothing here reads or writes stat_data: the HOST resolves which message
// carries the live state, which is what retires the stale-iframe hazard an in-frame write carries
// (pack-authoring-plan §B.7d). This runtime is CHROME: it observes where a click sat and
// what the player typed, and posts exactly that; every judgment about what the write MEANS lives in
// the pack's own engine (§B.7e).
//
// Every action has exactly ONE producer — a human clicking — so a single in-flight gate is the whole
// concurrency answer: refuse while one action is outstanding and a menu-versus-menu lost update
// cannot happen. The gate lives here because "this button is busy" is presentation, not a judgment.
//
// Carries `export` for its pure decisions (node-testable, tools/test-pack-layout.mjs) — legal and
// inert inside the exported document's single <script type="module">, like rt_packLayout.js.
// Reads actionNameProblem / actionArgsProblem (rt_htmlGenerators.js), packScopeOf (rt_packLayout.js)

// The wire to mvu-helper's dispatcher. PUBLISHED in authority §9a; the cross-repo test pins all
// THREE spellings (that doc, mvu-helper's constant, this one) so no two can agree without it.
export const MENU_ACTION_MESSAGE = 'mvu-statusmenu-action';
export const MENU_ACTION_RESULT_MESSAGE = MENU_ACTION_MESSAGE + '-result';
export const MENU_ACTION_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;

// ── pure decisions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// What a call will post, validated BEFORE posting: a plain name, plain JSON args, plus the renderer's
// own observation of where the click sat (`scopePath`, '' at root). Chrome sites build `args` in code
// and come through here; a baked button's data-args string is parsed first (planMenuActionRequest).
// { ok, action, args } or { ok:false, reason }. The refusal here IS the guard — the host's reader
// normalises args and would accept a prototype key as an honest one.
export function planMenuActionCall(action, args, scopePath) {
    const nameProblem = actionNameProblem(action);
    if (nameProblem) return { ok: false, reason: nameProblem };
    const argsProblem = actionArgsProblem(args === undefined ? {} : args);
    if (argsProblem) return { ok: false, reason: argsProblem };
    return { ok: true, action, args: Object.assign({}, args || {}, { scopePath: String(scopePath || '') }) };
}

// A data-args attribute → { ok, args } ('' or null → {}), or { ok:false, reason }.
export function parseDataArgs(argsText) {
    if (typeof argsText !== 'string' || !argsText.trim()) return { ok: true, args: {} };
    try { return { ok: true, args: JSON.parse(argsText) }; }
    catch (e) { return { ok: false, reason: 'data-args is not valid JSON: ' + e.message }; }

// A baked button's request: data-action + data-args (a JSON string, '' or null for none).
export function planMenuActionRequest(action, argsText, scopePath) {
    const parsed = parseDataArgs(argsText);
    if (!parsed.ok) return { ok: false, reason: parsed.reason };
    return planMenuActionCall(action, parsed.args, scopePath);

// The args a list cell declared for the rows it renders (its container's data-args), merged UNDER the
// click's own observations so a declared key never overrides listPath/itemKey. '' or null → {}.
// Not valid JSON → {} plus the reason, so the caller can say so instead of posting half a call.
export function mergeCellArgs(cellArgsText, clickArgs) {
    let declared = {};
    let reason = '';
    if (typeof cellArgsText === 'string' && cellArgsText.trim()) {
        try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(cellArgsText);
            if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) declared = parsed;
            else reason = 'the cell\'s data-args is not a JSON object';
        } catch (e) { reason = 'the cell\'s data-args is not valid JSON: ' + e.message; }
    }
    return { args: Object.assign({}, declared, clickArgs || {}), reason };
}

// The in-flight gate. ONE outstanding action at a time; nothing queues, nothing re-snapshots.
export function menuActionGateDecision(inFlight) {
    if (!inFlight) return { allow: true, reason: '' };
    return { allow: false, reason: 'action "' + inFlight.action + '" is still in flight — one at a time' };
}

// ── runtime ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

let _menuActionInFlight = null;   // { action, startedAt } until the host replies or the wait times out
let _menuActionSeq = 0;

function postMenuAction(action, args) {

        const requestId = 'ma-' + (++_menuActionSeq);

// The button's state, readable by CSS ([data-action-state]) and by a hover (title = the reason).

// THE ONE DOOR every menu write goes through. Gate → validate → post → report → re-read.
// Returns { ok, reason, applied, refused } so chrome can react (revert a checkbox, keep a form open,
// close a modal) — it never throws, and it never touches state itself.
// `ui.button` (optional) gets the busy/done/refused marks a baked button shows.
async function dispatchMenuAction(action, args, scopePath, ui) {
    const button = ui && ui.button;
    const gate = menuActionGateDecision(_menuActionInFlight);
    if (!gate.allow) {

        return { ok: false, reason: gate.reason, applied: 0, refused: [] };

    if (!plan.ok) {

    _menuActionInFlight = { action: plan.action, startedAt: Date.now() };

        if (!reply) {
            const reason = 'mvu-helper did not answer within ' + MENU_ACTION_TIMEOUT_MS + 'ms — is the extension installed and up to date?';

            markMenuActionState(button, 'refused', 'no answer from mvu-helper');
            return { ok: false, reason, applied: 0, refused: [] };
        }
        if (!reply.ok) {
            console.warn('[MZSMB][action] "' + plan.action + '" refused by the host: ' + reply.reason);

            return { ok: false, reason: reply.reason || 'refused', applied: 0, refused: [] };
        }
        const refused = Array.isArray(reply.refused) ? reply.refused : [];
        console.log('[MZSMB][action] "' + plan.action + '" applied ' + reply.applied + ' op(s)'
            + (refused.length ? ' — REFUSED by the card schema: ' + refused.join(', ') : ''));
        markMenuActionState(button, 'done', '');

        // re-read now instead of waiting for the 2 s poll.
        if (typeof refreshFromMvu === 'function') await refreshFromMvu();
        return { ok: true, reason: '', applied: reply.applied, refused };
    } finally {
        _menuActionInFlight = null;
    }
}

async function runMenuActionFromButton(button) {
    const scopePath = typeof packScopeOf === 'function' ? packScopeOf(button) : '';
    const parsed = parseDataArgs(button.getAttribute('data-args'));
    if (!parsed.ok) {
        console.warn('[MZSMB][action] not posted — ' + parsed.reason);
        markMenuActionState(button, 'refused', parsed.reason);
        return;
    }

// ONE delegated listener for the document — pack tabs and the card's own tabs alike, rows cloned
// later included. Called from the export's init chain, never at load: the pure half above must import
// into node (tools/test-pack-layout.mjs) without a document.
function wireMenuActionClicks() {

export function parseRowActions(text) {

// An option is a bare scalar or { value, label }: the label is what the form shows, the value is

export function optionValue(option) {

export function optionLabel(option) {
    if (option && typeof option === 'object') return String(option.label === undefined ? option.value : option.label);

// What the engine's declaration still needs from the player. A `pick` with exactly ONE option is
// not a choice and is answered here without asking; everything else is asked. A declared `value` is
// a DEFAULT the form shows, never an answer — the engine asked, so the player is asked.
// Returns { args: the pre-answered {name: value}, ask: the inputs the form must draw }.
export function planInputAnswers(inputs) {
    const args = {};

    for (const input of Array.isArray(inputs) ? inputs : []) {
        if (input.kind === 'pick' && Array.isArray(input.options) && input.options.length === 1) {

// The form's raw reads — a field's string, a checkbox's boolean, a select's option INDEX — typed by
// the KIND the engine declared. This is the one typing the runtime may do: the engine said "number",
// so a number is what it asked for; the form is not guessing (§B.7e.6). A read that cannot satisfy
// its kind refuses the whole submit naming the field, and nothing is posted.
// Returns { ok, args } or { ok: false, reason }.
export function readInputAnswers(inputs, raw) {
    const args = {};
    const values = raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {};
    for (const input of Array.isArray(inputs) ? inputs : []) {
        const value = values[input.name];
        const shown = input.label || input.name;
        switch (input.kind) {
            case 'number': {
                const text = value === undefined || value === null ? '' : String(value).trim();

                args[input.name] = Number(text);
                break;

            case 'boolean':
                args[input.name] = value === true || value === 'true';
                break;
            case 'pick': {
                const options = Array.isArray(input.options) ? input.options : [];
                const index = Number(value);
                if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0 || index >= options.length) return { ok: false, reason: '"' + shown + '" needs one of its options' };
                args[input.name] = optionValue(options[index]);
                break;
            }
            default:
                args[input.name] = value === undefined || value === null ? '' : String(value);
        }
    }
    return { ok: true, args };
}

// ── runtime ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

let _inputsSeq = 0;

// Ask the host what an action needs, handing it the row's observations so the engine can compute
// candidates FOR this row. Resolves the host's { ok, inputs } | { ok: false, reason }, or null when
// nothing answered in time.
function postActionInputsRequest(action, args) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const requestId = 'mi-' + (++_inputsSeq);
        const onMessage = (event) => {

            if (!d || d.type !== MENU_ACTION_INPUTS_RESULT_MESSAGE || d.requestId !== requestId) return;

// One declared row verb, clicked. Confirm (presentation) → ask the engine what it needs → answer
// what is not a choice → draw the rest → post through the one door. `row` is what the click
// observed ({ listPath, itemKey }), `cellArgsText` the list cell's own data-args, `origin`
// { scopePath, button }. Precedence, most specific first: the row's observations, the row action's
// static args, the cell's args — a declared key never overrides what the click saw.
async function runRowAction(rowAction, row, cellArgsText, origin) {

    }

    if (merged.reason) console.warn('[MZSMB][action] ' + rowAction.action + ': ' + merged.reason + ' — posting without the cell\'s args');
    const scopePath = String((origin && origin.scopePath) || '');
    const button = origin && origin.button;

    const reply = await postActionInputsRequest(rowAction.action, Object.assign({}, merged.args, { scopePath }));
    if (!reply) {
        const reason = 'mvu-helper did not answer the inputs request within ' + MENU_ACTION_INPUTS_TIMEOUT_MS + 'ms — is the extension installed and up to date?';

        alert(rowAction.title + ' refused: ' + reason);
        return { ok: false, reason, applied: 0, refused: [] };

    if (!reply.ok) {
        console.warn('[MZSMB][action] "' + rowAction.action + '" inputs refused by the host: ' + reply.reason);

        return { ok: false, reason: reply.reason || 'refused', applied: 0, refused: [] };

    if (!plan.ask.length) {
        const result = await dispatchMenuAction(rowAction.action, Object.assign({}, merged.args, plan.args), scopePath, { button });
